description_en: Retrieves information about all available governance evaluation items, including names, IDs, descriptions, stages, resource detail metadata, and remediation guidance
description_zh: 获取所有可用的治理检测评估项的信息，包括名称、ID、描述、阶段、资源明细元数据和修复指引
kebab_example: aliyun governance list-evaluation-metadata --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-language zh --lens-code ack --topic-code ResourceUtilization --evaluation-domain example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEvaluationMetadata

parameters.help_en:
The language type. Governance evaluation definitions are returned in this language. Valid values:

en: English.
zh: Chinese
parameters.help_zh:

parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en:
The specialized evaluation code. Valid values:

basic (default): foundation model (governance maturity) evaluation.
ack: container building specialized evaluation.
ai: machine learning specialized evaluation.
nis: network service specialized evaluation
parameters.help_zh:

ack：容器构建专项检测。
ai：机器学习专项检测。
nis：网络服务专项检测
